arxiv-1907-11541.title: Phase Transition Unbiased Estimation in High Dimensional Settings
arxiv-1907-11541.creator: Stéphane Guerrier, Mucyo Karemera
arxiv-1907-11541.description: Abstract An important challenge in statistical analysis concerns the control of the finite sample bias of estimators. This problem is magnified in high dimensional settings where the number of variables p p diverge with the sample size n n .

arxiv-2103-05549.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by B. Belfatto, and Z. Berezhiani. Recent high precision determinations of V u ​ s V_{us} and V u ​ d V_{ud} indicate towards anomalies in the first row of the CKM matrix. arxiv-2105-03897.title: Binarized Weight Error Networks With a Transition Regularization Term
arxiv-2105-03897.creator: Savas Ozkan, Gozde Bozdagi Akar
arxiv-2105-03897.description: Abstract This paper proposes a novel binarized weight network (BT) for a resource-efficient neural structure. The proposed model estimates a binary representation of weights by taking into account the approximation error with an additional term. This model increases representation capacity and stability, particularly for shallow networks, while the computation load is theoretically reduced.

arxiv-2211-09028.title: Neural Network Prior Mean for Particle Accelerator Injector Tuning
arxiv-2211-09028.creator: Connie Xu, Ryan Roussel, Auralee Edelen
arxiv-2211-09028.description: Abstract Bayesian optimization has been shown to be a powerful tool for solving black box problems during online accelerator optimization. The major advantage of Bayesian based optimization techniques is the ability to include prior information about the problem to speed up optimization, even if that information is not perfectly correlated with experimental measurements.

arxiv-2212-09041.title: Configurational temperature in active matter. II. Quantifying the deviation from thermal equilibrium
arxiv-2212-09041.creator: Shibu Saw, Lorenzo Costigliola, Jeppe C. Dyre
arxiv-2212-09041.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Shibu Saw, Lorenzo Costigliola, Jeppe C. Dyre. This paper suggests using the configurational temperature T conf {T}_{\rm conf} for quantifying how far an active-matter system is from thermal equilibrium. We measure this “distance” by the ratio of the systemic temperature T s {T}_{\rm s} to T conf {T}_{\rm conf} , where T s {T}_{\rm s} is the canonical-ensemble temperature for which the average potential energy is equal to that of the active-matter system.

arxiv-2307-13135.creator: Shaojun Ma, Mengxue Hou, Xiaojing Ye, Haomin Zhou
arxiv-2307-13135.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Shaojun Ma, Mengxue Hou, Xiaojing Ye, Haomin Zhou. We present a novel computational framework for density control in high-dimensional state spaces. The considered dynamical system consists of a large number of indistinguishable agents whose behaviors can be collectively modeled as a time-evolving probability distribution. The goal is to steer the agents from an initial distribution to reach (or approximate) a given target distribution within a fixed time horizon at minimum cost.

arxiv-2312-17223.title: Complexity-Theoretic Implications of Multicalibration
arxiv-2312-17223.creator: Sílvia Casacuberta, Cynthia Dwork, Salil Vadhan
arxiv-2312-17223.description: Abstract We present connections between the recent literature on multigroup fairness for prediction algorithms and classical results in computational complexity. Multiaccurate predictors are correct in expectation on each member of an arbitrary collection of pre-specified sets. Multicalibrated predictors satisfy a stronger condition: they are calibrated on each set in the collection.

arxiv-2401-16076.title: Find the Cliffhanger: Multi-Modal Trailerness in Soap Operas
arxiv-2401-16076.creator: Carlo Bretti, Pascal Mettes, Hendrik Vincent Koops, Daan Odijk, Nanne van Noord
arxiv-2401-16076.description: Abstract Creating a trailer requires carefully picking out and piecing together brief enticing moments out of a longer video, making it a challenging and time-consuming task. This requires selecting moments based on both visual and dialogue information. We introduce a multi-modal method for predicting the trailerness to assist editors in selecting trailer-worthy moments from long-form videos.

arxiv-2406-02654.title: kNN Classification of Malware Data Dependency Graph Features

arxiv-2406-02654.description: Abstract Explainability in classification results are dependent upon the features used for classification. Data dependency graph features representing data movement are directly correlated with operational semantics, and subject to fine grained analysis. This study obtains accurate classification from the use of features tied to structure and semantics.

pmc-10598418.title: Looming-eyes buoys fail to reduce seabird bycatch in the Icelandic lumpfish fishery: depth-based fishing restrictions are an alternative

pmc-10598418.description: Bycatch in gillnets from lumpfish (Cyclopterus lumpus) fisheries is an important conservation issue in the north Atlantic, with up to 30 000 seabirds potentially killed each year. pmc-11535348.description: The production of cellulose derivatives using ionic liquid (IL) as solvents and catalysts has become prominent over the last few years, since the process eliminates the use of toxic substances. Gasless endoscopic surgery via subclavicular approach (ESSA) may provide a better alternative.

pmc-13034283.creator: I-Ling Huang, Jin-Biau Li, Min-huey Chung
pmc-13034283.description: AbstractObjectivesThis study explored the lived experiences of internet addiction among Taiwanese junior college students. Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Under such procedure any material or product which the Secretary finds is technically suitable.
